page_title: RBL 4-2 WER | RB Leipzig v Werder Bremen 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Peter Gulacsi comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+4' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
90+4' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

90+3' 4 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 4:2.
90+2' Tobias Reichel interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' 4 - 1 Goal! Andre Silva tees up Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the right side of the goal. 4:1.
89' Total attempts – 15:6.

81' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
79' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.

78' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the left post!
78' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
77' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Michael Zetterer stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
77' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
75' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Kevin Kampl will be replaced by Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig).

72' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
72' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

70' Some great controlled play and passing from Werder Bremen. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

54' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Werder Bremen! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Tobias Reichel and both teams have no complaints.

54' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Werder Bremen.
54' David Raum (RB Leipzig) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
53' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.

42' RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
